title: Mixture of experts surrogate model for the homogenization of open-porous materials
summary: For open-porous materials, incorporating their microstructural properties into mechanical simulations poses a significant challenge for accurately capturing elastic deformation. To deal with this difficulty, multiscale methods are a common tool to couple characteristics of the microstructure of the considered material with the macroscopic material behavior. However, when desiring a high accuracy, these multiscale computations can be computationally very expensive due to the large number of microscopic problems which need to be solved in each compute step.
